title: Flat Loss, Evolving Features: Grokking in Modular Addition
abstract: arXiv:2610.22593v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can a network keep learning while its training cross-entropy stays nearly flat at a positive level? We show that it can. On modular addition, a standard testbed for grokking, ReLU networks trained with supported-Polar hidden updates, normalized output-layer updates and weight decay can keep 100% training accuracy while their hidden features change and held-out accuracy rises from zero to above 90%, at relatively flat training cross-entropy. Correct classification need not minimize cross-entropy, which still depends on prediction confidence. We prove this coexistence for one-hidden-layer networks in two finite-window theorems from constructed initializations: one gives a constant gain in the Fourier fraction of the hidden features, and the other holds at arbitrarily low positive loss, where a readout refitted on the training data generalizes before the network. translated_title: 平坦损失与演化特征：模加法中的顿悟现象
translated_abstract: 当一个网络的训练交叉熵几乎平坦地停留在正的水平上时，它还能继续学习吗？我们证明它可以。在模加法这一grokking的标准测试平台上，使用supported-Polar隐藏层更新、归一化输出层更新和权重衰减训练的ReLU网络，可以在训练交叉熵相对平坦的情况下保持100%的训练准确率，同时其隐藏特征持续变化，留出集准确率从零上升到90%以上。正确分类并不需要最小化交叉熵，因为交叉熵仍然依赖于预测置信度。我们通过两个基于构造初始化的有限窗口定理，对单隐层网络证明了这种共存性：其中一个定理给出隐藏特征的傅里叶占比的恒定增益，另一个定理则在任意低的正损失下成立，此时在训练数据上重新拟合的读出层会先于网络本身实现泛化。从随机初始化出发的实验在窗口上同样显示了这种共存现象。
tldr: 该论文证明网络可以在训练交叉熵几乎平坦地保持正值的条件下继续学习：在模加法任务上，ReLU网络在保持100%训练准确率的同时隐藏特征持续演化、留出集准确率从零升至90%以上，并通过两个有限窗口定理从理论上证明了这种平坦损失与顿悟式泛化的共存性。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that networks can keep learning while training cross-entropy stays nearly flat at a positive level: on modular addition, ReLU networks maintain 100% training accuracy while hidden features evolve and held-out accuracy rises from zero to above 90%, with two finite-window theorems proving this coexistence of flat loss and grokking.
